description: The unit of parallelism (D-065 (4), plan v3 §4.3, P-04).

units.bytes_per_token.description: Bytes of code per token when a closure is converted to tokens.
units.bytes_per_token.x-source: plan v3 §4.3 (~4 bytes per token, an estimate)

units.cochange_commits.description: Co-change window: the newest non-merge commits of the git log the generator reads.

units.cochange_max_files.description: A commit touching more production files than this is a bulk change and is left out of co-change.
units.cochange_max_files.x-source: plan v3 §4.1 (p90 of 40 files per PR)

units.cochange_weight.description: Weight of co-change (share of commits touching both sets) in the affinity of two candidates.

units.companions.description: Companion files that follow their primary file's unit (TX21, T1/T2: derived, never hand-kept): a path matching `companion` belongs to the unit of `primary` with the same `*` (one path segment). A claim of the companion by that same unit is allowed; a claim by another unit is an error naming the manifest line to remove. A companion whose primary has no unit keeps its own claims.

units.context_budget.description: Context an agent needs to change a unit, at most.

units.decision_register.description: Register a manifest's budget override and decisions must cite (D-NNN rows).

units.event_producer.description: Producer name of the events the unit tools emit (unit.oversize, engine.step.measured).

units.import_extensions.description: Suffixes tried, in order, to resolve an extensionless TypeScript or JavaScript import.

units.import_weight.description: Weight of import density (links per file of the smaller set) in the affinity of two candidates.

units.manifest_dir.description: Directory that holds one folder per unit, units/<id>/.

units.manifest_file.description: File name of a unit manifest inside units/<id>/.

units.manifest_schema.description: JSON Schema every unit manifest satisfies.

units.measure_step.description: Step name of the unit measurement in engine.step.measured.

units.merge_floor_lines.description: A candidate below this many production lines joins its closest sibling while the pair stays within units.size_target.

units.merge_min_affinity.description: Least affinity at which the clustering of a flat file group merges two clusters.

units.oversize_fails.description: Whether a unit above its size ceiling fails the ownership check; false reports it as a warning while U4 splits today's large contexts. Flipped to true by one PR citing D-067.

units.owners.description: Lanes a manifest may name as owner (D-065 (4), D-069 item 8); a lane exclusively owns its units.
units.owners.x-source: D-067; plan v3 §4.5 cells and §9.2 A2 lanes

units.production_globs.description: Globs of the files that are production code or build data; each must belong to exactly one unit (minus units.test_globs).

units.python_import_dirs.description: Directories a Python sibling import (import config) resolves against, besides the importer's own.

units.size_ceiling.description: Production lines a unit may not exceed; above it unit.oversize is emitted.

units.size_exempt_globs.description: Production files that count toward no unit size: data files (JSON catalogs, baselines, snapshots, configs; D-064 amendment) and generated files.

units.size_target.description: Production lines a unit aims at; above it the unit is a candidate to split.

units.test_globs.description: Globs of test and fixture files inside the production globs; they belong to at most one unit and count toward no size.

units.tsconfig_files.description: TypeScript configs whose compilerOptions.paths resolve import aliases for the import graph. Empty: the engine has no TypeScript package (OU-DECOUPLE F5, D-113); a product names its config here.
